t: The Brackenheath iSpot Frameless is a slimline 9W LED bulkhead designed for outdoor illumination. This wall-mounted light is ideal for securing commercial pathways and domestic building entrances. Delivering 1150 lumens of cool white 4000K light, the unit features an IP65 rated dustproof and waterproof polycarbonate body. A 4-in-1 control system operates via a 180° PIR and photocell sensor with a 10m range, offering flexible manual, dusk-to-dawn, or motion-activated settings. An integrated LED light source provides up to 30,000 hours of operation.
